top_signals.title: Oil prices little changed as market waits on deal to open Strait of Hormuz
top_signals.summary: News of Iran's restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz sent oil prices higher, renewing concerns over supply disruptions.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Garbage-Truck Margin Boost Shows the AI Profit Boom Has Begun
top_signals.summary: Corporate America’s adoption of artificial intelligence tools is paying off, in a major relief to investors who had questioned massive investments in the technology by a concentrated number of companies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: CEX perpetual futures volume falls to $4T, lowest since late 2023
top_signals.summary: Perpetual futures trading volume on crypto exchanges fell to its lowest level in 31 months, while perpetual trading on decentralized platforms neared a one-year low.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
